name: Alhabia (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and yellow in the proportions 1:2, the green charged with a yellow pitcher.
history: Authorised by the Junta de Andalucía in July 1996, the symbols were adopted at the end of 2004; the flag is a rectangular cloth of proportions 1:2 divided vertically, green at the hoist and gold yellow at the fly, the green half charged with a yellow pitcher half the height of the flag.
